subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Produzir jornais radiofônicos ou televisivos e entrevistas veiculadas em rádio, TV e na internet, orientando-se por roteiro ou texto e demonstrando conhecimento dos gêneros jornal falado/televisivo e entrevista.

components.description_pt: Produzir noticiário de rádio ou televisão orientado por roteiro ou texto escrito
components.description_en: Produce a radio or television news broadcast guided by a script or written text
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a live or recorded performance interprets and alters elements of a written text

components.description_pt: Produzir entrevista para rádio, televisão ou internet orientada por roteiro preparado
components.description_en: Produce an interview for radio, television, or internet guided by a prepared script
components.cc_component_description: Speak clearly at an understandable pace during a prepared oral presentation

components.description_pt: Demonstrar conhecimento de convenções do gênero noticiário falado e entrevista em produção oral
components.description_en: Demonstrate knowledge of the spoken news broadcast and interview genre conventions in oral production
components.cc_component_description: Apply knowledge of language conventions when speaking or presenting

cc_matches.description: Report on a topic or text or present an opinion, sequencing ideas logically and using appropriate facts and relevant, descriptive details to support main ideas or themes; speak clearly at an understandable pace.
Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.

Compare and contrast the experience of reading a story, drama, or poem to listening to or viewing an audio, video, or live version of the text, including contrasting what they "see" and "hear" when reading the text to what they perceive when they listen or watch.
